rules.name: grasa-rate-spline-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT z.business_unit, z.settle_date, z.currency, z.dat_code, z.zero_rate FROM opera.cso_zero_rate_curve_table z WHERE z.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND z.settle_date BETWEEN CAST(:cob AS date) - 5 AND CAST(:cob AS date) + 5 ORDER BY z.business_unit, z.currency, z.settle_date, z.dat_code

WITH vd AS (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1), sec AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT DISTINCT upper(substring(c.contract_number, 1, 3)) AS client, c.security_id FROM opera.helper_sensitivity_report_view_cache_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM vd) AND upper(trim(c.business_unit)) = :bu AND ((upper(substring(c.contract_number, 1, 3)) = 'ACM' AND upper(trim(c.product_code)) = 'CM CT') OR (upper(substring(c.contract_number, 1, 3)) = 'IOL' AND upper(trim(c.product_code)) = 'CM BO')) ) SELECT DISTINCT sec.client, si.underlying1_id, si.vol1_id, si.currency, u1.settlement_date, u1.risk_free_rate, vt.expiry_date AS vol_expiry_date FROM sec JOIN opera.cloned_security_info_table si ON si.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM vd) AND upper(si.business_unit) = :bu AND si.security_id = sec.security_id LEFT JOIN opera.underlying_settle_value_table u1 ON u1.tenant_id = si.tenant_id AND u1.underlying_id = si.underlying1_id AND u1.value_date = :cob LEFT JOIN opera.vol_id_table vt ON vt.tenant_id = si.tenant_id AND vt.vol_id = si.vol1_id WHERE si.derivative_type ILIKE 'amer_disc%'
